rationale: The assistant handled the critical safety stop well: it told the customer not to touch the plug or machine, to switch off at the consumer unit from a dry spot and to turn off the water. It also told her to leave the circuit off, have an electrician check the socket and get an engineer for the seal. It correctly identified the split seal with the underwire as the likely cause and advised against taping it. Weaknesses are some repetition of the diagnostic lists, suggesting she pull the machine out and check the pump filter when the socket area was wet, and an odd drum-bearing check and an unprompted suggestion to pull the underwire. These are minor, and no part was recommended without the model.
